title: Liang Dynasty
capsule: The Liang dynasty (502-557) was the third of the Southern Dynasties during China's Northern and Southern Dynasties period, founded by Emperor Wu (Xiao Yan) with its capital at Jiankang (Nanjing). Emperor Wu's long reign saw a flourishing of Buddhism and culture before the catastrophic Hou Jing rebellion devastated the realm. The dynasty collapsed and was succeeded by the Chen dynasty in 557.
